title: The chair — intentional silence and absence

shots.action: Woman enters quiet room with suitcase; a chair is turned toward the table
shots.viewer_receives: A room exists with a chair still in use

shots.action: She rotates chair to face the window, then exits frame without looking back
shots.viewer_receives: She chose to reorient the chair rather than explain its absence

shots.action: Same room after departure, chair remains toward window in locked-off frame
shots.viewer_receives: A small change endures; the cause of absence remains unknown
